head: cloud/cache-capability-records
title: refactor(cache): declare a continuation capability for every model family
body:
Implements cache redesign card 18.

- Each model directory gets `cache_capabilities.hpp` with a `gufo::cache::Capabilities` record. Qwen3 ASR, Qwen3 TTS, Qwen Image 2.1 and MiniMax H3 declare `continuation = false`. Qwen 27B (`src/models/qwen`), Flash-Next and DeepSeek declare `continuation = true` and leave `persistent_encoding` to their adapters (cards 14–17).
- `cache_model_capabilities_test` (hosted `check-pr`) lists `src/models/`. It fails when a directory has no record, a record has no directory or appears twice, or a record claims persistent encoding without continuation.
- ASR/TTS state check: neither reuses state across requests. Each request prefills its own prompt. Live ASR WebSocket sessions transcribe each committed buffer as an independent request. Streamed TTS segments are separate `/v1/audio/speech` requests. So no separate future capability is recorded. The card is marked done.

No runtime behavior changes. Nothing includes the records outside the test yet.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (Linux x86-64 cloud VM, no GPU, Ubuntu system GCC/CMake 3.28 rather than the Nix toolchain):
- `cmake --preset cpu-test && cmake --build --preset pr --parallel 4`: 55/55 hosted tests passed (on main at #517), including the new `cache_model_capabilities_test` and `cache_boundary_test`.
- Negative checks of the new test against a copied `src/models`: an extra directory with no record fails, and so does a removed directory that still has a record.
- `tools/ci/check-format.py` with the Nix-pinned clang-tools: PASS. `tools/ci/check-docs.py`: PASS. `tools/ci/check-pr-title.py`: PASS.
- Not run: GPU, model, or functional tests (none apply to declaration-only headers), and `nix build .#checks.x86_64-linux.pr`.
